log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Pelipper
Gholdengo used Make It Rain → Rotom

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Swampert-Mega in back. Lead Gholdengo+Incineroar to remove Altaria first — Gholdengo resists Draco Meteor and Moonblast (Steel), immune to WoW and Taunt (Good as Gold), Shadow Ball SE vs Dragapult/Annihilape. Incineroar Fake Out disrupts turn 1, Intimidate debuffs Garchomp, Parting Shot safely pivots into Pelipper+Swampert-Mega rain mode once Cloud Nine Altaria is gone. Fire-type Incineroar immune to burn. Back Pelipper Drizzle+Swampert-Mega Swift Swim outspeeds entire opponent te
decisions.notebook: G2-G3 plan confirmed: Lead Gholdengo vs Altaria leads. Gholdengo resists Draco Meteor (Steel resists Dragon, NVE 0.5x) and Moonblast/Light of Ruin (Steel resists Fairy, NVE 0.5x). Good as Gold blocks ALL status moves including Taunt — Annihilape cannot lock out Recover. Shadow Ball SE vs Dragapult and Annihilape (Ghost SE vs Ghost). Earthquake is Gholdengo's main weakness (SE from Ground vs Steel). Thunderbolt is neutral vs Gholdengo (Electric vs Steel neutral). Incineroar Fire-type immune to burn — WoW useless vs it. Intimidate dead vs Annihilape (Defiant) and Dragapult (ClearBody) but useful vs Garchomp. Parting Shot is the pivot tool to bring in Pelipper+Swampert-Mega safely. Rain mode (Pelipper Drizzle + Swampert-Mega Swift Swim) is the endgame win condition once Cloud Nine Altaria is removed. Floette-Eternal (Floettite, FlowerVeil, Timid) — Gholdengo resists its Fairy STAB, Make It Rain SE but self-drops SpA; prefer Shadow Ball chip. Opponent Altaria: Focus Sash + Cloud Nine + Roost + Draco Meteor + WillOWisp + Tailwind — pure stall, cannot threaten Gholdengo. Dragapult (161-213 Jolly) is fastest opponent threat; in rain Swampert-Mega (164-268) outspeeds it.

decisions.rationale: Altaria's Cloud Nine is the hardest rain counter available, shutting off Swift Swim and Hurricane accuracy. Rotom-W resists both Water and Ice from Swampert while 4x threatening Pelipper with Thunderbolt. Garchomp in back provides the essential Ground-type EQ for Gholdengo (2x) and Life Orb pressure. Floette-Eternal serves as the Mega with powerful Fairy STAB to close games once Steel-types are removed. The lead pair covers each other's weaknesses cleanly.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's rain team: Pelipper (Damp Rock, Drizzle) + Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim, Ice Punch) is primary mode. Gholdengo (Modest, Leftovers, Good as Gold) is bulky win condition; must remove with super-effective Ground or Ghost before it snowballs. Incineroar (Careful, Sitrus, Fake Out/Parting Shot/Flare Blitz) cycles Intimidate and pivots. Farigiraf (Armor Tail) blocks priority and enables Ally Switch mindgames. Houndoom (Flash Fire, Focus Sash) absorbs Fire moves aimed at Gholdengo. Game 2: plan to lead Cloud Nine + Electric to dismantle rain opening, preserve Garchomp for Gholdengo.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (pri+3) flinches Altaria, blocking Tailwind — the single most dangerous opposing setup. Shadow Ball chips 32-73%, combined with Fake Out chip sets up next-turn KO to remove Cloud Nine and enable rain mode. Incineroar may eat Hydro Pump (45-75%, 80% acc) but survives with Sitrus Berry. Worth the risk vs letting Tailwind go up.
decisions.notebook: G2 T1: Opponent leads Altaria(FocusSash/CloudNine/Timid) + Rotom-Wash(SitrusBerry/Levitate/Timid). Altaria is the priority removal target — Cloud Nine blocks Drizzle rain. Fake Out+Shadow Ball on Altaria to flinch+chip for next-turn KO. Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump SE vs both Gholdengo(Steel) and Incineroar(Fire) at 2x; 80% acc. Incineroar Fire-immune to WoW; Gholdengo burn irrelevant (uses SpA). After Altaria removed → bring Pelipper(Drizzle)+Swampert-Mega(SwiftSwim) for rain sweep; Swampert-Mega 164-268 in rain outspeeds Dragapult 161-213. Opponent backline: Floette-Eternal(Floettite/FlowerVeil/Timid), Garchomp(LifeOrb/RoughSkin/Jolly), Annihilape(Leftovers/Defiant/Jolly), Dragapult(MuscleBand/ClearBody/Jolly). Intimidate useless vs Annihilape(Defiant)+Dragapult(ClearBody) but useful vs Garchomp. Gholdengo Shadow Ball SE vs Dragapult+Annihilape(Ghost). Parting Shot pivot to bring Pelipper/Swampert after Altaria removed.

decisions.rationale: Protect at +4 outruns Fake Out, so Rotom always blocks it. Altaria sets Tailwind freely while Cloud Nine stays to suppress Drizzle. Next turn both outspeed everything and can Hydro Pump Incineroar (63–145% OHKO range) or pivot Garchomp in to threaten Gholdengo with EQ (53–163%). No status works into Good as Gold or Fire-type, so attacking/support lines are the only real options.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 opponent led Gholdengo (Modest Leftovers Good as Gold) + Incineroar (Careful Sitrus Fake Out/Parting Shot/Flare Blitz) instead of rain. Cloud Nine suppresses Drizzle on any Pelipper switch. Garchomp Life Orb EQ threatens 53–163% on Gholdengo — preserve Garchomp as primary Gholdengo removal. Farigiraf (Armor Tail, Lum) blocks priority and enables Ally Switch; Houndoom (Flash Fire, Focus Sash) absorbs Fire moves aimed at Gholdengo. Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim) and Pelipper (Damp Rock) remain the rain endgame.

decisions.rationale: Shadow Ball targets Altaria at 42% for likely KO (29.7-82.2%). Parting Shot hits Rotom-Wash (safe target even if Altaria KO'd first since Gholdengo 106>Incineroar 80), drops SpA to reduce incoming special damage, and pivots to Pelipper/Swampert. If Altaria is KO'd, switch-in enters without Cloud Nine → Drizzle activates. Shadow Ball chosen over Make It Rain for 100% accuracy; missing would be catastrophic.
decisions.notebook: G2 T2: Shadow Ball is NEUTRAL vs Altaria (Ghost vs Dragon 1x, not SE). Last turn SB did 45% (87→42). Altaria at 42% is possible but not guaranteed KO. Plan: KO Altaria → Parting Shot pivot brings Pelipper (Drizzle activates once Cloud Nine gone) → Swampert-Mega Swift Swim sweep. Altaria has no Protect (moves: DracoMeteor/WillOWisp/Tailwind/Roost). Tailwind from Altaria is the key threat — if it goes up, opponent backline (Dragapult 161-213, Garchomp 117-169) outspeeds everything. Rotom-Wash Protect used T1 (reduced success rate). Incineroar Intimidate useless vs Annihilape(Defiant)+Dragapult(ClearBody) but useful vs Garchomp.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper is mandatory: Cloud Nine is gone so Drizzle activates rain, unlocking Swampert-Mega Swift Swim. Without rain Swampert-Mega is 82-134 Spe and useless under opponent Tailwind. Pelipper also brings Tailwind to match theirs and Wide Guard for spread protection. Swampert comes later as the win condition.
decisions.notebook: G2 plan: Pelipper Drizzle (Cloud Nine now gone) → Swampert-Mega Swift Swim sweep. Opponent has Tailwind 4 turns; their backline all outspeeds my team without Swift Swim or own Tailwind. Rotom-Wash Protect used T1 (reduced). Rotom atk -2 spa -1 from Parting Shot. Incineroar Intimidate useless vs Annihilape(Defiant)+Dragapult(ClearBody) but useful vs Garchomp. Opponent brought 4: Altaria(fainted)+Rotom-Wash+2 unknown from {Floette-Eternal(Floettite),Garchomp(LifeOrb),Annihilape(Leftovers),Dragapult(MuscleBand)}. My intended Mega: Swampert. Floette-Eternal has Floettite but evaluated in base forme for me. Series: I lead 1-0.

decisions.rationale: Tailwind is the highest-value play: both mons are faster and it secures 4 turns of doubled speed regardless of Altaria's fate. Rotom Hydro Pump hits Incineroar before Parting Shot, with OHKO potential. Even if Altaria falls to Shadow Ball, Garchomp enters under Tailwind and threatens Gholdengo with Life Orb EQ. Will-O-Wisp is dead into both foes (Good as Gold + Fire type).
decisions.notebook: Game 2 opp leads Gholdengo (Modest Leftovers Good as Gold) + Incineroar (Careful Sitrus Fake Out/Parting Shot/Flare Blitz). Cloud Nine suppresses Drizzle. Garchomp Life Orb EQ OHKO range on Gholdengo: 53–163%. Floette-Mega has Fairy Aura (155 SpA). Farigiraf (Armor Tail Lum) blocks priority and enables Ally Switch. Houndoom (Flash Fire Sash) absorbs Fire for Gholdengo. Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim) and Pelipper (Damp Rock) rain endgame; preserve Altaria or Tailwind to answer rain speed.

Garchomp EQ can OHKO Gholdengo (34-151%), so Protect is mandatory. Switching Pelipper to Swampert brings in the Mega Swift Swim win condition: immune to Rotom Thunderbolt, resists Rock Slide, survives EQ (max 98%). Will-o-Wisp risk exists but burned Waterfall still hits Garchomp for 2x SE+STAB+rain. Once Tailwind expires in 3 turns, Swampert-Mega outspeeds their entire team.
decisions.notebook: G2: Swampert-Mega Swift Swim is primary win con in rain. Opponent Tailwind set T2, expires after T5. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim speed 164-268 in rain; under opponent Tailwind, Garchomp (234-338) may still outspeed. After Tailwind expires, Swampert-Mega outspeeds all opponent mons including Dragapult (161-213). Rotom-Wash at atk-2 spa-1 from Parting Shot T2. Garchomp EQ can OHKO Gholdengo (34-151% spread) — never leave Gholdengo in vs Garchomp EQ un-Protected. Swampert immune to Electric, resists Rock Slide, cannot be OHKO'd by EQ. Key risk: Rotom Will-o-Wisp on Swampert. Opponent backline: 2 unknown from {Floette-Eternal(Floettite), Annihilape(Leftovers,Defiant), Dragapult(MuscleBand,ClearBody)}. Incineroar Intimidate useful vs Garchomp but useless vs Annihilape(Defiant)/Dragapult(ClearBody). Series: I lead 1-0.

decisions.rationale: Rotom Thunderbolt guaranteed OHKOs Pelipper regardless of Wide Guard. Garchomp EQ hits Gholdengo for 71-162% under Tailwind, outspeeding both foes. Levitate protects Rotom from EQ. Even if Wide Guard blocks EQ, Pelipper falls and Gholdengo is the lone active. Worst case both target Garchomp with spread + single, but combined damage (62-131%) only KOs on high rolls. This maximises pressure while removing rain support.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opp leads Gholdengo (Modest Leftovers Good as Gold) + Incineroar (Careful Sitrus). After Turn 2 Parting Shot, Pelipper (Bold Damp Rock) enters; rain+Tailwind both up. Bench: Swampert-Mega (Swift Swim rain sweeper), Houndoom (Sash Flash Fire), Farigiraf (Lum Armor Tail Ally Switch). Opp wincon: preserve rain/Pelipper for Swampert-Mega clean. My Tailwind expires end of Turn 5; Floette-Mega still in back. Altaria (Cloud Nine Sash) fainted Turn 2.

decisions.rationale: Switching Gholdengo to Incineroar avoids EQ KO bait, fires Intimidate on Garchomp, and preserves Gholdengo for late game. Swampert Protects+Mega Evolves to gain Swift Swim safely, blocking Rotom's Will-o-Wisp and EQ chip at 47% HP. T5: Incineroar Fake Out flinches Garchomp (priority), Swampert-Mega Ice Punch 4x SE KOs or heavily damages it. T6: Tailwind gone, Swampert-Mega outspeeds all remaining foes.
decisions.notebook: G2: Swampert-Mega Swift Swim primary win con in rain. Opponent Tailwind set T2, expires after T5. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim speed 164-268 in rain; under opponent Tailwind, Garchomp (234-338) still outspeeds. After Tailwind expires T6, Swampert-Mega outspeeds all opponent mons including Dragapult (161-213). Rotom-Wash at atk-2 spa-1 from Parting Shot T2. Garchomp EQ can OHKO Gholdengo — never leave Gholdengo in vs Garchomp EQ un-Protected. Swampert immune to Electric, resists Rock Slide, neutral to EQ. Key risk: Rotom Will-o-Wisp on Swampert. Incineroar Intimidate useful vs Garchomp but useless vs Annihilape(Defiant)/Dragapult(ClearBody). Incineroar Fake Out re-usable after switching out and back in. Plan: T4 switch Gholdengo→Incineroar+Swampert Protect+Mega; T5 Fake Out Garchomp+Ice Punch KO; T6+ clean up with Swampert-Mega outspeeding all. Series: I lead 1-0.

decisions.rationale: Pelipper is the superior bring: Wide Guard shields Swampert from spread EQ/Rock Slide, and Pelipper's 4x Thunderbolt weakness forces Rotom to KO it rather than burn Swampert. Swampert stays at 47% unburned, Ice Punches Garchomp at full power for the KO, then sweeps from T6 when Tailwind expires. Gholdengo at 100% waits in back for endgame support vs Rotom/Floette.
decisions.notebook: G2: Swampert-Mega Swift Swim primary win con in rain. Opponent Tailwind set T2, expires after T5. Swampert-Mega Swift Swim speed 268 in rain; under opponent Tailwind, Garchomp (234-338) still outspeeds, Rotom (200-302) speed-ties. After Tailwind expires T6, Swampert outspeeds all opponent mons including Dragapult (161-213). Rotom-Wash at atk-3 spa-1 from Parting Shot T2 + Intimidate T4. Garchomp atk-1 from Intimidate T4. Garchomp EQ possible OHKO on Gholdengo (41-125%) — never leave Gholdengo in vs Garchomp EQ un-Protected. Swampert immune to Electric, resists Rock Slide, neutral to EQ. Garchomp EQ on Swampert ~14-23% with atk-1 (survives from 47%). Ice Punch 4x on Garchomp: 74-162% — likely KO from 80% but not guaranteed vs bulky spreads. Key risk: Rotom Will-O-Wisp on Swampert cripples sweep. Pelipper 4x weak to Rotom Thunderbolt (guaranteed OHKO) — useful as Thunderbolt lure to protect Swampert from burn. Incineroar fainted T4 (EQ+Hydro Pump). Series: I lead 1-0. Plan: T5 bring Pelipper+Wide Guard+Swampert Ice Punch Garchomp; T6+ Swampert sweeps with Gholdengo backup vs Rotom.

decisions.rationale: Wide Guard (pri +3) blocks Garchomp's Rock Slide/Earthquake spread, protecting both mons. Not Protecting Pelipper lures Rotom Thunderbolt (guaranteed 4x OHKO), keeping Swampert safe from Will-O-Wisp burn — the crippling threat. Swampert Ice Punch (4x SE, 68-181%) likely KOs Garchomp from 80%. Even if Pelipper falls to Thunderbolt, rain persists (Damprock) and Swampert sweeps T6+ when Tailwind expires. Acceptable sacrifice.
decisions.notebook: G2 T5 plan executed: Wide Guard+Ice Punch Garchomp, Pelipper as Thunderbolt lure. After T5 Tailwind expires, Swampert-Mega (268) outspeeds all opponent mons incl Dragapult (161-213). If Swampert burned, Ice Punch at half power (34-90%) may not KO Garchomp from 80% — need backup plan. Gholdengo immune to status moves (Good as Gold) — valuable vs Will-O-Wisp/Taunt. Rotom-Wash spa-1 atk-3 from Parting Shot+Intimidate. Garchomp atk-1 from Intimidate. Series 1-0 my lead. Double-target Swampert punishes the near-certain Pelipper Protect. Combined damage floors at 51.2% even with -1 Atk/SpA, guaranteeing KO from 46% when Hydro Pump hits. Garchomp survives any single hit; Floette cleans up the 20% miss scenario. Losing Swampert cripples their rain sweep.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Opp rain mode Pelipper+Swampert-Mega confirmed. Swampert Mega Speed 164-268 in rain. Gholdengo Modest Leftovers, Houndoom Timid Sash Flash Fire, Farigiraf Bold Lum Armor Tail Ally Switch. Swampert Protect used Turn 4 (reduced next use). Floette Energy Ball OHKOs Swampert from 46%.

Rotom Thunderbolt is a guaranteed OHKO on Pelipper even at spa-1; Protect is mandatory. Gholdengo Make It Rain hits Floette for 59-154% (possible KO, guaranteed heavy damage) while Gholdengo survives any single hit (LoR 29-48%, TBolt 32-55%). Even if opponent predicts Protect and double-targets Gholdengo, combined max is ~103% — unlikely KO. Tailwind is too risky since Pelipper (85 spe) moves after both foes and dies before it resolves if targeted.
decisions.notebook: G2 durable facts: Rotom-Wash Thunderbolt guaranteed OHKOs Pelipper even at spa-1 (148-246%). Floette Energy Ball is NEUTRAL on Pelipper (Water 2x × Flying 0.5x = 1x, 29-46%). Gholdengo Make It Rain does 59-154% to Floette (2x SE, spread 0.75x) — possible OHKO. Floette Light of Ruin only 29-48% on Gholdengo (Steel resists Fairy 0.5x). Rotom Thunderbolt 32-55% on Gholdengo (neutral, spa-1). Double-target Gholdengo (TBolt+LoR) = 62-103%, possible but unlikely KO. Pelipper 85 spe is slower than all foe mons; Tailwind won't resolve if Pelipper is KO'd first. Win con: get Tailwind up via Pelipper so Gholdengo (106→212) outspeeds Dragapult (161-213) and Annihilape (104-156) in back. Pelipper must survive to set Tailwind — Protect mind game needed. Gholdengo is primary win condition; Floette is primary KO target (2x Make It Rain). Rotom is hard to kill (0.25x from Make It Rain) but spa-1 atk-3 severely weakens it.

1v3 SpA-2; Shadow Ball is SE on both possible Ghost switch-ins. If Dragapult comes in, its Dragon Darts is only 8-17% (NVE) and Shadow Ball has ~34-102% chance to KO at SpA-2. If Annihilape comes in, I'm likely KO'd regardless of choice (Protect only delays one turn). Shadow Ball maximizes the only real win path.
decisions.notebook: Opponent G3 roster: Altaria (Cloud Nine, Timid, FocusSash, DracoMeteor/WillOWisp/Tailwind/Roost), Garchomp (RoughSkin, Jolly, LifeOrb, EQ/DragonClaw/RockSlide/Protect), Rotom-Wash (Levitate, Timid, Sitrus, HydroPump/TBolt/WillOWisp/Protect), Floette-Eternal (FlowerVeil, Timid, Floettite, LightOfRuin/Moonblast/EnergyBall/Protect), Annihilape (Defiant, Jolly, Leftovers, RageFist/DrainPunch/Taunt/Protect, base Spe 90), Dragapult (ClearBody, Jolly, MuscleBand, DragonDarts/Uturn/WillOWisp/Protect). Key G3 notes: Altaria Cloud Nine cancels Drizzle — Pelipper rain can be negated; consider leading without weather dependence. Floette Mega is special nuke (140 BP Light of Ruin). Annihilape likely outspeeds Gholdengo (106) with Jolly+EVs. Drain Punch immune on Ghost types. Opponent double-targets to KO priority threats. Plan: lead Pelipper+Swampert-Mega for swift swim offense; Incineroar Intimidate for physical attackers; Gholdengo endgame cleaner — avoid Make It Rain SpA self-drops, prefer Shadow Ball targeting.

decisions.rationale: Hydro Pump is the only path to any win chance: rain-boosted STAB can OHKO Gholdengo on a high roll (~28% chance factoring accuracy and -1 SpA). Thunderbolt never KOs and Protect only delays. Must hope Gholdengo attacks instead of Recovering, or that Hydro Pump high-rolls through a Recover turn.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump rain-boosted OHKOs Houndoom (even -1). Gholdengo Good as Gold blocks status. Farigiraf Armor Tail blocks pseudo-priority but irrelevant here. Opponent likely plays safe with Recover while 3v1 up.

decisions.rationale: Rotom-Wash speed range (100-151) vs Gholdengo 106 is uncertain; if Rotom outspeeds, Recover and Shadow Ball are dead turns (Hydro Pump KOs at 19% first). Protect (priority +4) guarantees survival this turn regardless of speed order, buying one turn for Rain to tick down and Leftovers to heal, giving a small chance at Hydro Pump miss or opponent misplay next turn.

decisions.rationale: Rotom is guaranteed faster than Gholdengo (151 vs 89–136). Thunderbolt is a guaranteed KO from 18% and 100% accurate, while Hydro Pump's 20% miss chance is an unnecessary risk. Good as Gold blocks Will-O-Wisp. After KO, face Houndoom/Farigiraf 1v2 with Hydro Pump PP preserved.

reflections.summary: Altaria's Cloud Nine negated Drizzle, stripping Swampert-Mega of Swift Swim speed and leaving the rain core dysfunctional. Swampert was outsped and worn down before it could trade effectively. Gholdengo's Make It Rain SpA drop crippled its endgame damage, causing it to lose the 1v1 to Rotom-Wash despite favorable positioning. The four brought and the Mega choice were fundamentally mismatched against an opponent packing a dedicated weather-nullifier.
reflections.adjustment: Do not bring the Pelipper+Swampert-Mega rain core into Altaria Cloud Nine without a plan to remove Altaria first. Either lead with Incineroar+Gholdengo to pressure Altaria immediately, or bring a different Mega that does not depend on rain. If Gholdengo stays, never use Make It Rain — stick to Shadow Ball to preserve SpA for the endgame.
reflections.notebook: Opponent tendencies: Altaria Cloud Nine confirmed in battle — Drizzle fully negated, Swift Swim inactive while Altaria alive. Rotom-Wash speed >106 (outspeeds Gholdengo). Floette Light of Ruin 140BP OHKO'd Pelipper. Gholdengo Make It Rain SpA-2 makes it lose 1v1 vs Rotom-Wash; Shadow Ball alone insufficient after drop. Opponent double-targets to secure KOs and brings Altaria specifically as rain counter. G3 plan: Do not lead Pelipper+Swampert into Altaria; either bring different Mega or prioritize KOing Altaria before rain matters. Gholdengo must avoid Make It Rain entirely. Watch Annihilape Taunt and Dragapult Wisp — neither appeared game 2 but remain threats for game 3.

reflections.summary: The opponent's Gholdengo misplayed by using Protect consecutively, causing it to fail and allowing Rotom-Wash to land the game-winning Hydro Pump. Rotom-Wash's rain-boosted damage and Sitrus Berry recovery outlasted Gholdengo, whose Special Attack was already lowered by its own Make It Rain.
reflections.adjustment: For game 3, bring a more reliable Gholdengo answer—such as a physical attacker that can OHKO or a Taunt user to block Recover—and reconsider Floette-Eternal's fragility against Steel-types. Consider leading with Altaria to reset weather with Cloud Nine and pressure with Draco Meteor, or use a different Mega that matches up better against the opponent's likely Gholdengo + rain core.
reflections.notebook: Gholdengo may attempt consecutive Protects under pressure. Make It Rain sharply lowers its SpA, reducing its threat after use. Floette-Eternal's Light of Ruin recoil is severe (~56% vs neutral), leaving it easily KO'd by Steel moves. Rotom-Wash with Sitrus Berry can win 1v1 against a weakened Gholdengo in rain. Opponent's Swampert carries Ice Punch for Garchomp. Expect possible Houndoom (Flash Fire, Focus Sash) or Farigiraf (Ally Switch, Armor Tail) in game 3. Prioritize a dedicated Gholdengo check and preserve Rotom-Wash for the rain match-up.
